main_body: Market stall counter: a wooden counter with produce on its top, under a green and white striped awning with a back shelf
top_band: Lighter brown counter top at rows ~26-29, with produce and peach highlight dashes on it, then a step to the darker brown front face
evidence: Down the middle column there is a lighter counter-top band (about rows 26-29) carrying the vegetables, then a tone step to the darker plank front (rows 30-41) with a dark base. The top reads as a horizontal surface because the produce sits on it. There is no inset front and no clear shadow under the edge, but the structure matches the Beodeul stall counters.

style.evidence: The awning has several green and white steps, and the wood counter has speckled grain with a few highlights. Outlines are dark purple-brown tints, not pure black. The produce is detailed with highlights. The counter front is a large area but carries grain dots. Overall it is close to the reference stalls, if slightly simpler.
